intro.speaker: Elder Maren
intro.text: The rifts tear wider every night. Centers of us are gone; the town counts on you now.

boss_hint.speaker: Elder Maren
boss_hint.text: Old tales speak of a Magma Golem deep in the caves. Strike when it stops glowing!

smith_intro.speaker: Smith Torvald
smith_intro.text: Bring me gold and I will temper steel. Use my station whenever you like.

smith_upgrade.speaker: Smith Torvald
smith_upgrade.text: Heart, arm, shield, boots - any of them can be made better. Even your weapons.

scout_intro.speaker: Scout Lira
scout_intro.text: Each portal leads to one of the rift scars. Locked ones open only after their keeper falls.

scout_portals.speaker: Scout Lira
scout_portals.text: There is always a way back home - the blue return portal never closes.

prisoner_found.speaker: Chained Rogue
prisoner_found.text: Whoever you are... the golem's chains hold me. Break the beast and I'm free.

prisoner_free.speaker: Vex
prisoner_free.text: Free at last! These daggers and I owe you one. Take care out there.
